purpose: Prevent wrong-region contact handoff and rebuild candidates from the translated player pose

evaluation.stability_gate: at least 9/10 success, zero 300-step failures, and at least one success after coordinate recovery
evaluation.smoke_result: Final smoke v2: 1/3, Wilson 95% 6.2%-79.2%, mean 230.3, median 300, two 300-step failures. Diagnostic smoke v1 before the trace-driven stale-cooldown fix was 2/3.
evaluation.fixed_result: Not run because the final smoke gate failed.

failure_analysis.smoke_v1: 2/3. Seed 16500 rebuilt at step 229, but old candidate cooldown expired during the 36-step scan and the stale route was selected again.
failure_analysis.trace_driven_fix: Coordinate recovery without translation progress now triggers immediate current-pose relocalization, and old cooldown candidates stay locked through the episode during a rebuild.
failure_analysis.smoke_v2: 1/3. Seed 16500 rebuilt earlier at step 146 but the new local contact did not finish; seed 16501 broke a log at step 83 but downstream drop recovery failed; seed 16502 succeeded in 91 steps.
failure_analysis.remaining_bottleneck: Upstream handoff observability improved, but end-to-end stability remains limited by local contact completion and drop pickup after a valid handoff.

note: Independent upstream repair profile. v9.2 and older profiles remain frozen. Privileged crosshair raycast is allowed; oracle distance and log grids remain excluded. No episode or contact timeout is extended. Fixed evaluation and training were not started because final smoke failed.
